description: This file defines the OA_Dll_User class, which extends the base OA_Dll class and manages user-related operations such as validation, creation, deletion, retrieval, and account linking within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Dll_User
classes.description: Class managing user data operations including validation, creation, deletion, retrieval, and account linking.

methods.name: _setUserDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates a OA_Dll_UserInfo object with data from an array, mapping database fields to object properties.

methods.name: _validateAuthentication
methods.description: Validates user authentication data using the configured authentication plugin.

methods.name: _validateUsername
methods.description: Checks if the username is allowed and unique.

methods.name: _validateDefaultAccount
methods.description: Validates that the default account is linked to the user.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of user data, including structure, existence, and authentication.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Creates or updates a user record, handling permissions and optional welcome email.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user by user ID after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user information for a specified user ID.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.

methods.name: getUserListByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific account ID.

methods.name: updateSsoUserId
methods.description: Updates the SSO user ID for a user.

methods.name: updateUserEmailBySsoId
methods.description: Updates the email address for a user identified by SSO ID.

methods.name: linkUserToAccount
methods.description: Links a user to an account with specific permissions.

methods.name: linkUserToAdvertiserAccount
methods.description: Links a user to an advertiser account after validation.

methods.name: linkUserToTraffickerAccount
methods.description: Links a user to a trafficker account after validation.

methods.name: linkUserToManagerAccount
methods.description: Links a user to a manager account after validation.

methods.name: checkAccountType
methods.description: Checks if an account has a specific account type.
